title: Evaluation of a one-input gate
statement: Let $k$ be a gate kind other than negation, let $a$ be a natural-number input index, and let $v$ be a list of Boolean values. The gate of kind $k$ with sole input $a$ evaluates to the value of $v$ at index $a$, taking an out-of-range index to have value false.
hypotheses_covered: The gate kind is not negation
